startUrls.title: Websites
startUrls.description: Business websites to scan. Domains (acme.com) or full URLs. You can also upload a text or CSV file of URLs here.

websites.title: Websites (plain list)
websites.description: Alternative to Websites for API and agent use: a plain array of domains or URLs.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Pages per website
maxPagesPerSite.description: We read the homepage, then the contact, legal-notice (Impressum), about and team pages. 8 finds most contacts; more pages cost more compute, not more per-site fees.

includePhones.title: Phone numbers
includePhones.description: Validated with libphonenumber and normalised to +E.164.

includeSocials.title: Social profiles
includeSocials.description: LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Telegram.

validateEmails.title: Check email domains (MX)
validateEmails.description: Flags addresses whose domain cannot receive mail.

aiSummary.title: AI company summary
aiSummary.description: One-line description and industry per website with contacts. Charged as a separate event. Never invents contact data.

onlyWithContacts.title: Only output websites with contacts
onlyWithContacts.description: Skip rows for empty and unreachable sites (they are free either way).

includeDetails.title: Include full details (JSON)
includeDetails.description: Adds a nested 'details' object per website (confidence, MX status, every source page). Off by default because it turns a CSV export into hundreds of columns; the flat columns already include every value and its source page.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Websites processed in parallel. Automatically capped by the run's memory (4 at 512 MB, 11 at 1 GB, 26 at 2 GB).
